old.priorPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE original transparent full-body Rift of Reason creature cutout. Image1: approved STYLE BOARD, authoritative cute-horror storybook ink outlines, soft textured cel shading, warm expressive animal faces and dusk jewel accents. Image2: shipped Astrophysicat, rendering reference only; do not copy cat anatomy, its clothes/stars/gesture. Match this game, not nursery pastels, realistic celebrity likeness or glossy3D. No humans. Center the entire coherent silhouette at about80percent of the canvas so ears/props/feet/tail have transparent padding. No background, floor, ground-shadow blob, frame, text, letters, logo, watermark, particles or extra figures. Art will sit ABOVE a separate shipped card frame with live names/rules/stats. Face and one signature prop readable at70px, attractive at300px; medium dark brown outlines, ink/violet shadows and warm lantern rim light. Public-persona joke only, no private-life/scandal jokes or copied lyrics/quotes/costumes. Subject: Rick Ash-tley, an ORIGINAL NONHUMAN creature inspired by Rick Astley's public persona. Silhouette/costume: Small rounded roach with a neat reddish crest, silver-grey raincoat and charming raised brow. Main prop/gesture: One plain microphone; modest mid-step pose is a broad pop-stage cue. Visual joke: The familiar performer returns just when the audience expected someone else. Use jewel accent #C9C9D6 on worn dark cloth/trim, no invented branding. Pose/composition: three-quarter right-facing calm pose. A fish/dolphin remains fish-shaped with fins/tail rather than human legs; a bird/bat retains wings/beak/ears. One bold recognition cue; keep small ornaments minimal. No extra props or scene. Entire figure/prop comfortably inside transparent canvas. Recorded composition variation: slightly low camera angle, big theatrical surprise. This overrides a generic standing/right-facing/wide-eyed smile; keep species/prop/colour and coherent anatomy. Do not add extra text or scenery.
